title: Azusawa Kohane — Tiny Timid Creature〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, are you free this weekend?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This weekend? Um, I am meeting with someone from another school on Saturday, but I'm free on Sunday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! Then do you wanna go to Phoenix Wonderland together on Sunday?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
My mom received a pair of tickets from a friend, you see!
So she asked me to go enjoy myself with another friend.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry, maybe you don't like theme parks?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What? N-Not at all! I like theme parks, and PXL...
I mean, Phoenix Wonderland is a place that I really love to visit!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It always feels so homey.
Going there cheers me up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They've added some new attractions recently, but the nostalgic mood hasn't gone away.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They have a lot of fun and playful areas to go to besides the attractions too. And all the cast members of the park are super nice, too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, if you go during your birthday, they have a special...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh! I-I'm sorry.
I must be talking too much...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, I've never seen you talk so fast before, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You really love that theme park, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes. But it's a little childish, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No way! I love visiting the place too, and I'm pretty sure plenty of grown-ups do as well!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If we're going, we should definitely try out all the different attractions they have available!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case, i-if you'd like, I can come up with a route for that day?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Dad and I often visit the park together, so I know of a few shortcuts...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Looks like I've found the most reliable companion for this! Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay. I'll try to think of something nice. Oh, but...
Are you really sure you want to go with me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Why not?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, you mentioned that you've finally been able to talk to Kiritani lately, and she's your idol, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be better to invite her instead?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The thing is, when Mom gave me the tickets, I immediately thought of you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! That's why I wanted to invite you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Besides, you were the first friend I made in high school!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd love to go with Haruka one day, too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I've already decided that you're the one I wanted to invite first this time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-You were also the first friend I made in high school...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I'm really happy that you asked me to join you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sunday just can't come soon enough!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By the way, are there any attractions that we absolutely shouldn't miss in this park?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, it's not really an attraction, but we should definitely visit the recently revived Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes!
Oh, it may take a while for me to explain...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! We still have lots of time before lunch is over.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So what sort of performances are being shown there?
You know, on that...err, wonder place?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. The Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
The actors there are high school students like us!
They come up with the stage productions and effects themselves, and...
